text.p: An Israeli shot and killed a Palestinian who he suspected was trying to break into his house in southern Israel on Thursday, a police spokeswoman said.
She said the Israeli, a resident of the village of Kochav Michael, was detained for questioning.
The police spokesman said the Gazan worker, whom she identified as Samir Abu Shaqfa, 40, was employed by a neighbour of the Israeli gunman.
A senior Palestinian police officer in Gaza, Ziad al-Atrash, said four other Palestinian workers were wounded in the incident. The Israeli police spokeswoman said no one was wounded.

Atrash, head of the Palestinian side of a joint liaison committee with Israel, said the exact circumstances of the incident were not immediately clear but he discounted the possibility of a robbery, without elaborating.
Atrash said Palestinian authorities had asked Israel to set up a joint investigating team to look into the killing.
